chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: Welcome to the cooking show. Recipe is your map. Oven is the baker. Dinner plate is the robot tick. Same three steps every time.

chapters.title: Main path
chapters.text: You draw the pretty map. The importer builds an Auth box — a frozen card deck of Root, inputs, outputs, and nodes. Authoring on an entity only points at that Auth box. The bake oven reads the Auth box and freezes a brick. Play never opens the pretty map again.

chapters.title: Start door
chapters.text: The start door rule: exactly one Input wire must touch the first action box. Zero starts or two starts means the importer yells.

chapters.title: Extras
chapters.text: Variants pick a branch while baking, so unpicked paths disappear from the brick. The backpack holds live memory after bake.

nodes.user: You. The designer who wants a brain on the entity.
nodes.chat: Pretty map. Graph Toolkit source you edit. Humans draw here; bakers do not read this file at runtime.
nodes.planner: Importer. Reads the pretty map once and builds the Auth box plus node sub-cards.
nodes.router: Auth box is the imported result of your pretty map. After import, Grove no longer needs the drawing file for bake. This box holds the start Root, Inputs, Outputs, and every node as little cards. Authoring on a GameObject points here — not at the .mygraph.
nodes.approval: Start door check. The Auth box only gets a Root if exactly one Input boundary connects to an execution node.
nodes.blocked: Import error path. Fix the wires.
nodes.retry: Reimport after you fix the start door.
nodes.tool: Authoring component on a GameObject. Its job is only to point at an Auth box and optional overrides, then bake.
nodes.external: Bake oven. Reads the Auth box, applies variants and overrides, freezes a GraphData brick.
nodes.trace: Backpack and overrides live near play.
nodes.final: It runs. Robot can Execute the brick.
